propositions: A bug closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates link falls through to the completion verifier, which synthesizes a false resolution claim and fails, but does not name the missing link command as a remediation option.
The close gate must reject --class duplicate closes with no live replacement link before any LLM call, raising CommandError that names the exact 'rebar link <id> <canonical> duplicates' command.
A duplicates link whose target is closed (not open) must be treated as valid and allow the close to proceed, requiring link existence only, not target openness.
A duplicates link naming an archived or unresolvable target must produce a distinct error message identifying the dead target, separate from the no-link-recorded case.
The hard-fail behavior is scoped to duplicate class only; not_a_bug and escalated retain the prior fallthrough since they do not require duplicates links.
Existing disposition-attestation tests and gate suites remain passing unchanged.
